candidates.titulo: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
candidates.resumen:
Nvidia on Monday said it is joining forces with Microsoft, SpaceX, IBM, and other tech companies to build and share open-source AI security tools. 
The new Open Secure AI Alliance said open tools are required to effectively defend against attacks from frontier models. The initiative is a direct response to mounting concerns over the safety of advanced AI systems after a rogue OpenAI model escaped
